hero.title: Turn your rules into a game
hero.subtitle: Define and run score-based games: rules, points, badges, levels, challenges, teams and leaderboards, all powered by a rule engine you control.

highlights.title: Design your game
highlights.description: Start with the big picture. Combine point concepts, badges and level thresholds into a single game that reflects exactly what you want to reward, with no code required to get the structure right and no spreadsheet to keep in sync.

highlights.title: Build your rules
highlights.description: Turn conditions into logic with a visual rule builder backed by a real rule engine powered by Drools. Drag, connect and reuse conditions instead of hand-writing fragile scripts that break the moment something changes.

highlights.title: Simulate & test
highlights.description: Never guess what a rule change will do. Run it against a synthetic player first, inspect exactly what fires and what changes through a full impact analysis, and only publish once you're confident it's safe.

highlights.title: Track your players
highlights.description: Keep everyone racing for the top. Build all-time rankings or ones that reset every week or month, follow individual player profiles, and watch every leaderboard update live as scores change.

highlights.title: Run challenges
highlights.description: Turn goals into challenges players can actually chase. Assign them one-on-one or invite whole teams to compete, and reward automatically whoever crosses the line first, with no manual bookkeeping involved.

cta.title: Ready to build your first game?
cta.subtitle: Sign in and start defining rules, points and challenges in minutes.
